layman_headline: Both open trades are winning — SOL is approaching its profit target while the market recovers from fear.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just surged past $68,500 on news that the US Treasury doubled its debt buyback program, which is bullish for risk assets. Our Solana position is up 7.5% and closing in on its $85 exit target. Chainlink is up 3.8% and trending well too. The market mood is still cautious but improving fast, so we're letting winners run rather than opening new positions into an already-moved market.
layman_action: Hold current positions. SOL is nearing its $85 target — consider taking profits there. LINK has room to run toward $10.90. No new buys right now since the best candidates have already moved significantly this week.
expert_reasoning: Both SOL (+7.5%) and LINK (+3.8%) are performing well against their entry prices. SOL is only ~3.9% from its $85 exit target, making this a hold-and-monitor situation. The swing candidates list is weak: BTW is massively overbought at RSI 93, gold-backed tokens (XAUT, PAXG) offer no swing trade upside, and stablecoins are non-trades. ETH had a strong +9% day but lacks RSI/MACD data in the candidates list and has already moved substantially. The macro backdrop (Treasury buybacks, improving Fear & Greed from 35→46) supports holding risk-on positions but doesn't justify chasing after a broad 6-9% rally day. High BTC dominance at 57.1% continues to cap alt upside.
risk_factors: SOL is 72% below ATH — this recovery rally could stall at psychological resistance levels around $85-90
Fear & Greed at 46 is improving but still in Fear — sentiment could reverse quickly on negative macro news
BTC dominance at 57.1% means alts are underperforming on a relative basis and could give back gains if BTC consolidates
watch_list: SOL price action near $85 exit target — be ready to take profits
Bitcoin reaction at $69,500-$70,000 resistance zone — a rejection here could pull alts down
Fear & Greed trend — if it crosses 50 into neutral/greed territory, new alt entries become more attractive
market_context: Broad crypto rally today driven by macro tailwinds (US Treasury doubling buybacks). BTC up 5.8% to $68,558 hitting an 11-week high, with ETH and alts following. Sentiment improving from deep fear but still cautious.
context_banner: Strong macro-driven rally underway — hold existing winners and wait for pullback entries rather than chasing extended moves.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed improving from weekly avg of 34.9 to 46, showing recovering sentiment but still in Fear territory — supports holding but not aggressively adding.
US Treasury doubling buyback program is the primary catalyst for today's rally, crushing long-term yields and pushing capital into risk assets like crypto.
Bitcoin hitting 11-week high on Treasury buyback news confirms macro-driven momentum, but much of the move may already be priced in after a 5.8% daily candle.
BTW at RSI 93 is the only candidate with RSI data and is extremely overbought — no viable swing entry among the candidates list this cycle.
BTC volume at $29.6B and ETH at $13.3B indicate strong institutional participation in today's rally, supporting the bullish case for existing positions.
